title: introduce-tenant-scope-constraint-controller-and-stepwise-bootstrap-playbook
author: Asha Nair
description: Motivation: Private deployments require stricter tenant-scoped RBAC guarantees and safer upgrade/rollback behavior across Helm/Terraform flows. This PR adds a tenant-scope constraint controller that enforces the boundary of tenant-scoped roles and service accounts at install/upgrade time and introduces a stepwise bootstrap playbook and Helm preflight hooks to make seeding idempotent and reversible. Changes include a lightweight admission-style verifier used during bootstrap, Terraform plan guard integration that flags scope-expansion changes, Helm pre-upgrade hooks that stage role changes and a playbook that automates canary-seed, verify, and commit steps. Checklist: [x] controller implementation and unit tests; [x] Helm chart hook and templating; [x] Terraform module plan guard and example; [x] end-to-end staging run in internal infra; [x] docs and runbook; [ ] integration test against air-gapped installer (follow-up). Risk/rollback: The stepwise playbook supports abort/rollback during staged apply; the controller runs in dry-run by default for the first week in customer clusters (opt-out flag available). Related: ENG-1432, ENG-1498, SUP-889. How to verify: run installer with --bootstrap-plan to generate staged manifests, run helm upgrade --wait with opt-in flag, and exercise tenant onboarding flow using examples/tenant-smoke.yaml. Why different from prior PRs: this focuses on enforcement and staged rollout of tenant-level RBAC changes rather than bulk policy templating; it introduces guardrails that prevent accidental privilege expansion during private upgrades.

release_notes: Add tenant-scope constraint controller to enforce tenant RBAC boundaries during bootstrap and upgrades; introduce a stepwise bootstrap playbook with Helm preflight hooks and Terraform plan guard to reduce risk of privilege expansion during private deployments. Opt-in dry-run mode enabled by default for initial rollout.
troubleshooting_steps: If helm preflight fails, run installer with --bootstrap-plan to inspect staged manifests and run playbook step-by-step
To revert staged RBAC changes: run playbook rollback stage-1 then rollback-stage-0 and apply helm rollback
